contracts: play is self-contained ensure-constructed(source) plus prepare/play. construct is optional eager preparation; stop may discard it before consumption. A later play must construct if needed.
Commands and publication values contain source/session/operation/epoch metadata, never engine callback keys or engine pointers.

Binding replacement preserves source-operation preparation. Destination identity must be validated separately; replacement invalidates current traversal tickets.
Registry miss is unknown, not proof that an engine object is unowned or eligible for legacy COM replay.
Rate tests verify exact scaling, input rejection and transaction result using a clock spy. They do not execute or requalify the canonical clock algorithm.
